title: Why Do You Jerk Awake While Falling Asleep?
short_title: Why you jerk awake while falling asleep
description: Why do we suddenly jerk when falling asleep? The simple science of hypnic jerks.
tags: why do i jerk when falling asleep
comment: Has this happened to you? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why do you sometimes jerk awake, feeling like you are falling, just as you fall asleep?
It is called a hypnic jerk, or sleep start, and it is very common.
Scientists are not completely sure why. One idea is that the brain misreads relaxing muscles as falling.
It can happen more when you are very tired, stressed, or had caffeine late in the day.
For most people, it is harmless.
A steady sleep time and less late caffeine can help.
